sources.title: Corpus of Indus Inscriptions
sources.access: Opened online PDF; 35 extracted pages available in browser view. It identifies regions and coordinates for the source corpus site table.
locators: printed p. 26, book p. 34: ICIT and Mahadevan corpus totals by publication version
printed pp. 27-28, book pp. 35-36: Indus inscription sites by region and coordinates; Inter-Riverine, Lower Indus and Upper Indus site lists
printed p. 28, book p. 36 onward: site entries with ICIT ID, CISI identifier, type and inscription fields
sources.relevance: Substantial source for identifying the local corpus site population and keeping ICIT, object, text and sign totals distinct. The source's listed site rows are not an excavation census.

sources.title: Dr. V N Prabhakar

sources.relevance: Country-scope check for a local-corpus Inter-Riverine label. Karanpura is in India and is excluded from the Pakistan–Afghanistan rows.

sources.title: Written Answers to Questions, 6 May 2015, Unstarred Question No. 1090: Conservation and restoration of ancient Hindu monuments
sources.access: Official PDF opened; printed p. 121 inspected.
locators: Printed p. 121: Baror identified as District Sriganganagar, Rajasthan; Tarkhanwala Dhera as District Ganganagar, Rajasthan; Karanpura as District Hanumangarh, Rajasthan.
sources.relevance: Government source for excluding three India-side site labels from the user-defined Pakistan-only local-corpus additions. It also reports seal/sealing finds, without full object joins.
